description: fleet-hosted (#12583, component C of #9081): the hosted fleet front door — one Cloudflare Worker with route modules for the stamping, query, queue, ingestion and sync doors over one auth/tenancy plumbing layer. This slice is the skeleton: RP-token auth validation, tenancy mapping, health/capabilities; the doors are stubs the later C issues fill. Local-only; no deployment.
name: fleet-hosted

scripts.test: node --experimental-transform-types --test test/auth.test.ts test/tenancy.test.ts test/capabilities.test.ts test/doors.test.ts test/sessions.test.ts test/session-parity.test.ts test/stamp-sig.test.ts
